question: Are there independent, location- and date-stamped original observations of larvae of Junonia coenia and Anartia jatrophae feeding on exact introduced Plantago lanceolata, supporting a local pathogen bridge candidate?
query_rule: 2 pages per species at 256 observations per page; report capped/failed; save raw page SHA256 for reproducibility
strict_required: target Plantago lanceolata species not genus
valid dated event and actual coordinates
source-provenance not derived from global HOSTS compilation
original record or study citation identifiable
first_pass_output: Total GloBI rows, plant exact matches, explicit larval exact matches, georeferenced dated exact matches and source IDs; independent original source verification separately required
stops: No source -> do not infer field co-use
One species absent -> no present evidence for candidate heterospecific bridge
Any capped query -> do not claim exhaustive negative evidence
Geographic intersection at WGSRPD3 or state scale is insufficient for contemporaneous same-plant use
GloBI eats type alone without explicit larval stage is insufficient
